messages:
deploy-bot: Urgent hotfix request for embeddings-service. Image: rwinference/embeds:1.6.0-hotfix. CI green, preflight OK. Requesting expedited canary + fast ramp now. Logs: https://logs.redwood/embeds/3300012345 :rotating_light:

eng-lead-ana: Brief: small routing change caused tiny-batch misassignment -> p99 spikes. Patch is a targeted fallback fix. Rollback target: rwinference/embeds:1.6.0. Rollback triggers: p95 +250ms for 3m OR error-rate +0.8% sustained 3m.

sre-dan: SRE needs Eng + Product signoff and an owner to cut traffic. I can monitor and execute traffic cut. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/embeds-hotfix

product-maya: Product ACK. Impacting a small % of short requests; approve expedited rollout. Customer blurb: "Fix for intermittent latency on very short embedding requests; no model changes."

release-mgr-clare: Document approvals here. Eng?

eng-lead-ana: +1 from eng (codeowners). Plan: canary eu-west1 -> 20% 10m -> 80% 10m -> 100% if healthy. Keep rollback commands ready: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/embeds --to-revision=1.6.0` and traffic cut: `curl -XPOST https://ops-api/traffic/cut?service=embeds&target=1.6.0`

deploy-bot: Canary started on embed-canary-31. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/embeds/canary/3300012345

oncall-ryan: Oncall here. Pager set to urgent, I'll monitor metrics and post ROLLBACK INTENT if thresholds breached.

sre-dan: Canary health: initial checks PASS. p95 normalized after 4m.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 20% complete. Monitoring.

eng-lead-ana: Observing no regressions; proceed to 80%.
deploy-bot: 80% reached. Monitoring 10m checkpoint.

sre-dan: 7m into 80%: one noisy node reported higher CPU from unrelated job, not correlated. No alert breach.

oncall-ryan: Holding page 2h. If I post ROLLBACK INTENT I'll include metric snapshot and execute rollback commands immediately.
deploy-bot: Finalizing rollout -> switching 100% to rwinference/embeds:1.6.0-hotfix. Deployment complete. Artifact SHA: aa11bb22.

release-mgr-clare: Thanks team. Scheduling 1h post-deploy sync and 3h postmortem if needed. Draft release note posted: https://confluence.redwood/embeds/hf-1.6.0-hotfix.

eng-lead-ana: Follow-up: add a canary early-warning metric for tiny-batch p99 and a unit test for the routing fallback. Jira: https://jira.redwood/browse/ENG-10321

sre-dan: Closing monitoring loop: no rollback necessary. Will keep alerts on for 2h.

product-maya: Great job. Queue customer note in 30m after verification. :thumbsup:
